_note: Screening interview. 12 questions find the areas of a return. Each yes opens follow-ups, a document list, ledger categories and the usual ELSTER forms. Form names are the common ones; check the selected year in ELSTER.

questions.ask: Which tax year is this, and do you file alone or jointly with a spouse or registered partner?
follow_up: Married or partnered for the whole year?
Did you move or change tax class during the year?
Church member (Kirchensteuer)?
gather: last year's return and Steuerbescheid (tax assessment)
Steuer-ID (tax ID) of each person, kept local
any letters from the Finanzamt (tax office) this year

questions.ask: Were you employed, and by how many employers?
follow_up: Start and end dates of each job
Any severance, or a bonus or share plan that covers more than one year?
Did the employer reimburse any costs tax-free?
gather: Lohnsteuerbescheinigung (wage tax certificate) for each job
contracts or letters for severance or long-term incentive plans

questions.ask: Where did you work: office, home, or both? How far is your commute one way?
follow_up: Office days and home-office days in the year
Public transport costs, if higher than the distance allowance
Is there a separate room used only for work?
gather: a calendar or count of office and home days
public transport tickets
floor plan only if a separate work room is claimed

questions.ask: Did you pay for anything for work yourself: equipment, software, courses, books, job applications, work travel, union or professional fees?
follow_up: Purchase date and price of each item
Work share for mixed use
Useful life for items above the low-value limit
gather: every Rechnung (invoice) and receipt
bank or card statement lines for each
subscription list from bank, card and app stores

questions.ask: Do you have phone or internet contracts in your name that you also use for work?
follow_up: Monthly cost of each
Credits or welcome bonuses during the year
A three-month log of work use, if more than the flat 20 % is claimed
gather: all monthly bills for the year

questions.ask: Did you have any freelance, business or side income, including fees, platform sales or one-off jobs?
follow_up: Total income and costs
VAT registered or small business (Kleinunternehmer)?
Was the work started, changed or ended this year?
gather: invoices you sent
receipts for business costs
an EÜR (income-surplus statement) if one exists
forms: Anlage S or G (self-employed or trade)

questions.ask: Do you own property that you rent out, or did you buy or sell property this year?
follow_up: Purchase date, price, building year and contract date
Rent received and when the tenant moved in
Loan, interest and fees for the mortgage
Repairs, Hausgeld (owners' service charge) and the part of it paid into the owners' reserve
Empty months before the first tenant
gather: purchase contract and notary invoices
builder's final invoice or completion date
loan contract and yearly interest statement
Hausgeldabrechnung (owners' statement)
rental contract and rent received
official land value (Bodenrichtwert) for the building share

questions.ask: Did you have bank interest, dividends, funds, crypto, or a broker account, in Germany or abroad?
follow_up: Was the saver's allowance used in full by exemption orders?
Any foreign broker that did not withhold German tax?
Crypto sold within a year of buying?
gather: Jahressteuerbescheinigung (yearly tax certificate) from each bank and broker
foreign broker statements
crypto trade history

questions.ask: Did you receive benefits (parental, unemployment, sick or short-time pay) or any income from abroad?
follow_up: Type, period and amount of each benefit
Country and type of foreign income
Was foreign income taxed there?
gather: benefit certificates
foreign salary or tax documents

questions.ask: Do you have children, and did you pay for childcare or school?
follow_up: Birth dates and who received child benefit
Childcare invoices, paid by bank transfer
School fees for a private school
gather: childcare invoices and bank proof
school fee statements

questions.ask: Did you pay for insurance or pension yourself: private health, pension plans (Riester, Rürup), liability, disability or life insurance?
follow_up: Contributions paid this year
Were they already reported by the insurer?
gather: yearly contribution statements from each insurer

questions.ask: At home: did you pay a cleaner, gardener, craftsmen, or a service-charge bill? And did you have donations, high medical costs, or a move for work?
follow_up: Labour cost on each invoice, paid by bank transfer
The § 35a lines in the Nebenkostenabrechnung (service-charge statement)
Donation receipts
Medical costs not covered by insurance
gather: service-charge statement from the landlord or owners' association
craftsman and cleaner invoices with bank proof
donation receipts
medical invoices
moving invoices if the move was for work
